Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A line cook and a psychologist each showed up early to drop their kids off at daycare today. It's easy to tell that the psychologist has a close relationship with their kid based on how they hugged each other goodbye, but the line cook just seemed to push the kid out the door, and the kid didn't seem surprised by this at all. Who is a caring parent?
A. The line cook
B. Can't be determined
C. The psychologist
